summary: The phones, workwear, civic sash and wheeled luggage establish the Modern Age. The mayor and visitor have useful identity cues, but the first two everyday kits remain too similar, several garments lack construction, and the maintenance and guide hats visibly intersect the underlying hair.
problems: Plant Keeper and Canvas-Jacket Neighbour share almost the same plain torso-and-sleeve silhouette. Their small handheld props carry too much of the distinction at stream scale.
The plant resembles an ice-cream cone: a pointed brown container topped by one round green scoop.
The canvas jacket has no readable opening, collar or panels; the library regular's long rectangular garment and central stripe read more like a tunic than a modern cardigan.
Both maintenance variants and the tour guide have dark head/hair geometry protruding through their hat crowns.
The maintenance vest changes from muted blue-grey to purple across wearers. Its lone low reflective stripe does not create a strong, consistent safety-workwear identity from above.

The mayor's sash is effective, but the small badge and empty rectangular ribbon prop do not provide a strong permanent symbol of office. The guide's travel props establish a visitor, but the upper-body silhouette overlaps the local sunhat regular.
fix: Plant Keeper: Replace the pointed cone with a flat-bottomed terracotta cylinder and a wider rim; use two or three angular leaf clusters rather than one sphere. Add a clearly bounded gardening apron with contrasting straps and shorten the sleeves to distinguish this kit from the jacket. Seat the pot against the gripping hand. Canvas-Jacket Neighbour: Build an unmistakable waist-length jacket using a contrasting central opening, broad folded collar and two chunky front panels; keep the phone secondary rather than enlarging it into the main identifier. Sunhat Library Regular: Retain the successful broad hat and tote, but replace the central stripe with an open cardigan exposing a contrasting inner shirt. Shorten or split the lower front so the rigid hips-mounted garment cannot bridge moving thighs; attach the tote handles visibly to the hand. Town Maintenance Worker: Replace or suppress hair geometry beneath a properly fitted cap crown on both body variants. Use a fixed bright safety-yellow or orange vest over contrasting sleeves, with broad reflective shoulder strips connected to the waist band; retain the toolbox and boots. Mayor of the Civic Ribbon: Keep the dark suit and broad gold sash. Add a large, high-mounted civic medallion on a chunky chain, connect the sash over the shoulder, and replace the empty rectangular frame with a short solid ceremonial ribbon held at one end. Simplify the scissors into a clean, readable silhouette without making the event props compete with the office insignia. Far-Routes Tour Guide: Fit a rounded modern travel-hat crown over the actual head/hair bounds, removing all protrusions. Give the guide a distinct high-contrast travel vest and a short raised guide pennant, while retaining the scarf and stickered suitcase as arrival cues. Keep the suitcase outside the leg swing and its handle in the hand. Check every kit on both bodies in walking poses and at the actual 40-degree stream camera.
